blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Metro Cebu’s air quality reached “Acutely Unhealthy” levels early Saturday, September 19, according to the Environmental Management Bureau in Central Visayas (EMB-7), which recorded the classification at 4 a.m. The deterioration began late Friday, with the Metro Cebu monitoring station in Talisay City logging “Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups” to “Very Unhealthy” […]...
